environment_note: Project builds, tests and background project work paused during measurement. Other desktop applications and unrelated background Python work remained active. Warm filesystem caches; no CPU or memory isolation.

method.cache: warm; inventory and warmups before measurement; no eviction
method.order: reverse lane order each round; baseline/candidate stay adjacent for each old path
method.wall: subprocess elapsed including time wrapper; excludes JSON checks and inventories
method.rss: standalone CLI peak resident bytes; macOS bytes or Linux GNU time KiB converted to bytes
method.limits: No universal speed claim or enforced CPU/RAM limit; host activity described separately.

transformations: Replace each absolute corpus path with a named <corpus:...> placeholder and executable command paths with <baseline>/<candidate>.
